title: galega lanceifolia
intro: Galega lanceifolia, commonly known as Goat's Rue, is a perennial flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to lower blood sugar levels and provide relief from inflammation and pain. The health benefits of Galega lanceifolia are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as hypoglycemic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
